meta.name: Camry 2.5L (XV70)
meta.summary: Front-wheel-drive mid-size sedan: 2.5 L A25A-FKS inline-4 (2,487 cc, 13.0:1, D-4S port + direct injection, 203 hp), 8-speed automatic, electric power steering, ABS/VSC, Toyota Safety Sense. Faults are OBD-II codes and dashboard warning lights; the fuse boxes are the cabinet views. 3D model to published dimensions; under-hood part positions are approximate.

components.name: Body shell
components.desc: Unibody sedan, 4,885 × 1,840 × 1,445 mm on a 2,825 mm wheelbase; track 1,600 / 1,605 mm; 145 mm ground clearance. Drawn see-through; use Hide guards to remove it.
components.src: published dimensions

components.name: A25A-FKS 2.5 L engine
components.desc: 2,487 cc DOHC inline-4, bore 87.5 × stroke 103.4 mm, 13.0:1, D-4S port and direct injection, VVT. Oil 0W-16, 4.8 qt (4.5 L) with filter.
components.src: A25A-FKS engine overview (cararac.com); 2022 Camry fluid types and capacities

components.name: 8-speed automatic (UA80E)
components.desc: Transverse 8-speed automatic with torque converter. Toyota ATF WS. Shudder on 1–2 or R–D shifts is a known complaint.
components.src: A25A-FKS engine overview (cararac.com); 2022 Camry fluid types and capacities

components.name: Radiator and cooling fans
components.desc: Radiator with two electric fans (FAN NO.1 60 A, FAN NO.2 50 A). Coolant Toyota SLLC, 9.1 qt (8.6 L).
components.src: fuseandrelay.com Camry XV70 fuse list (check against your box cover); 2022 Camry fluid types and capacities

components.name: 12 V battery
components.desc: 12 V starting battery in the engine bay.
components.src: automotive service practice

components.name: Alternator
components.desc: Engine-driven alternator on the ALT 120 A fuse; charging warning light if it stops charging.
components.src: fuseandrelay.com Camry XV70 fuse list (check against your box cover); Toyota warning lights guide (youcanic.com)

components.name: Starter motor
components.desc: Push-button start through the smart key system (ST NO.1 30 A).
components.src: fuseandrelay.com Camry XV70 fuse list (check against your box cover)

components.name: Engine compartment fuse and relay box
components.desc: Main fuses: ALT 120 A, EPS 80 A, cooling fans, ABS, EFI-MAIN, IG2-MAIN, headlights.
components.src: fuseandrelay.com Camry XV70 fuse list (check against your box cover)

components.name: Instrument panel junction block
components.desc: Interior fuse block under the dash (driver side): OBD, STOP, ECU-IG1/IG2, DOOR, RADIO, A/BAG and more.
components.src: fuseandrelay.com Camry XV70 fuse list (check against your box cover)

components.name: Engine control module (ECM)
components.desc: Engine and transmission control: reads the sensors, runs injectors, coils, VVT, throttle and fans; stores OBD-II codes.
components.src: automotive service practice

components.name: Air filter, MAF and throttle body
components.desc: Air cleaner, mass airflow sensor with intake temperature, electronic throttle.
components.src: automotive service practice

components.name: Exhaust, catalytic converter and O2 sensors
components.desc: Close-coupled catalyst with an air-fuel ratio sensor before it and an oxygen sensor after it; cooled EGR on this engine.
components.src: automotive service practice; A25A-FKS engine overview (cararac.com)

components.name: Fuel tank and pump
components.desc: About 15.8 gal tank (2.5 L models) with in-tank pump; 87 octane. Engine-driven high-pressure pump feeds the direct injectors.
components.src: automotive service practice

components.name: Front brakes and wheels
components.desc: Front discs and calipers, wheel speed sensors for ABS/VSC. Ø305 mm front rotors, 205/65R16 tires (LE).
components.src: automotive service practice

components.name: Rear brakes, wheels and parking brake
components.desc: Rear discs with the electric parking brake (on the ABS fuses); wheel speed sensors. Ø282 mm rear rotors.
components.src: fuseandrelay.com Camry XV70 fuse list (check against your box cover)

components.name: ABS / VSC actuator
components.desc: Hydraulic modulator and control for ABS, brake assist, EBD, TRAC, VSC and hill-start assist (ABS NO.1 50 A, ABS NO.2 30 A).
components.src: fuseandrelay.com Camry XV70 fuse list (check against your box cover)

components.name: Electric power steering
components.desc: Electric rack with its own motor and control (EPS 80 A).
components.src: fuseandrelay.com Camry XV70 fuse list (check against your box cover)

components.name: Instrument cluster and multi-info display
components.desc: Warning lights and messages; the master warning light points to a message on the display.
components.src: Toyota warning lights guide (youcanic.com)

components.name: OBD-II diagnostic connector
components.desc: Under the dash, driver side, on the OBD fuse. Plug a scan tool here to read codes and live data.
components.src: fuseandrelay.com Camry XV70 fuse list (check against your box cover)

components.name: A/C compressor and climate
components.src: 2022 Camry fluid types and capacities

faults.title: Random / multiple cylinder misfire
causes: Worn spark plugs or a failed ignition coil
checks: A flashing check engine light means an active misfire that can damage the catalyst: reduce load and get it checked
Read misfire counts per cylinder with a scan tool
Swap the coil from the misfiring cylinder to another and see if the misfire follows
Check plugs and for vacuum leaks
faults.src: SAE J2012 generic OBD-II definition; causes are general diagnostic practice; Toyota warning lights guide (youcanic.com)

faults.title: System too lean (bank 1)
causes: Vacuum leak after the MAF (intake hose, PCV)
Exhaust leak before the A/F sensor
checks: Look at short and long term fuel trims at idle and at 2,500 rpm
Smoke-test the intake for leaks
Clean or test the MAF
Check fuel pressure
faults.src: SAE J2012 generic OBD-II definition; causes are general diagnostic practice

faults.title: Catalyst efficiency below threshold (bank 1)
causes: Misfires or oil burning that damaged the catalyst
checks: Fix any misfire or lean code first
Compare upstream and downstream sensor signals: downstream should stay steady
Check for exhaust leaks near the sensors
faults.src: SAE J2012 generic OBD-II definition; causes are general diagnostic practice

faults.title: Coolant below thermostat regulating temperature
checks: Watch coolant temperature warm-up on a scan tool
Replace the thermostat if it never reaches normal temperature
faults.src: SAE J2012 generic OBD-II definition; causes are general diagnostic practice

faults.title: EVAP system leak
faults.msg: Check engine (or master warning: check fuel cap)
causes: Fuel cap loose or seal damaged
checks: Tighten or replace the fuel cap first
Smoke-test the EVAP system
faults.src: SAE J2012 generic OBD-II definition; causes are general diagnostic practice

faults.title: MAF sensor range / performance
causes: Air leak or clogged air filter
checks: Inspect the air filter and intake hose
Clean the MAF with MAF cleaner; compare grams/s to expected at idle
faults.src: SAE J2012 generic OBD-II definition; causes are general diagnostic practice

faults.title: Camshaft timing over-advanced (bank 1)
causes: Low or dirty oil (VVT runs on oil pressure)
checks: Check oil level and grade (0W-16)
Command the oil control valve with a scan tool
Check cam-crank correlation
faults.src: SAE J2012 generic OBD-II definition; causes are general diagnostic practice

faults.title: System voltage low
checks: Measure battery voltage engine off (about 12.6 V) and running (about 13.5–14.5 V)
Check battery terminals and the ALT fuse
Have the battery load tested
faults.src: SAE J2012 generic OBD-II definition; causes are general diagnostic practice; Toyota warning lights guide (youcanic.com)

faults.title: Low oil pressure warning
causes: Oil pump or pressure sensor fault
checks: Stop safely and switch off: don't drive with this light on
Check the oil level; top up with 0W-16
If the level is fine and the light stays on, tow it
faults.safety: Driving with low oil pressure can destroy the engine within minutes.

faults.title: Engine overheating
causes: Low coolant or leak (hoses, radiator, water pump)
Cooling fan or fan fuse/relay fault
checks: Pull over and let it cool; never open a hot radiator cap
Check coolant level and look for leaks
Check both fans run with the A/C on; check FAN NO.1/NO.2 and EFI NO.2 fuses
faults.src: Toyota warning lights guide (youcanic.com); fuseandrelay.com Camry XV70 fuse list (check against your box cover)
faults.safety: Never open the cooling system when hot.

faults.title: Brake system warning
causes: Low brake fluid (worn pads or a leak)
checks: Check the parking brake is released
Check brake fluid level (DOT 3/4) and pad thickness
If fluid is low with no leak, pads are worn; if leaking, don't drive

faults.title: ABS or VSC light on
causes: Wheel speed sensor or tone ring fault
checks: Read ABS/VSC codes with a scan tool that reads chassis codes
Inspect wheel speed sensor wiring at the wheel
Check ABS NO.1 (50 A) and ABS NO.2 (30 A) fuses
faults.src: Toyota warning lights guide (youcanic.com); fuseandrelay.com Camry XV70 fuse list (check against your box cover)

faults.title: Power steering warning
checks: Check battery voltage
Check the EPS fuse
Read codes from the EPS module
faults.src: Toyota warning lights guide (youcanic.com); fuseandrelay.com Camry XV70 fuse list (check against your box cover)

faults.title: Tire pressure warning
causes: TPMS sensor battery or sensor fault (light flashes then stays on)
checks: Set cold pressures to the door-jamb label
If it flashes for about a minute at start-up, a sensor needs service

faults.title: Transmission fluid hot / shift shudder
checks: Pull over and let it cool
Check for software updates and ATF condition (Toyota ATF WS)
Torque converter replacement is the usual fix for persistent shudder
faults.src: Toyota warning lights guide (youcanic.com); A25A-FKS engine overview (cararac.com)

faults.title: Won't start (no crank)
causes: Smart key not detected (weak key battery)
Starter, ST fuse or immobilizer fault
checks: Press the brake firmly and hold the key fob against the start button
Check battery voltage
Check ST NO.1 30 A fuse
faults.src: fuseandrelay.com Camry XV70 fuse list (check against your box cover); automotive service practice

faults.title: Airbag (SRS) light stays on
causes: SRS fault stored (seat connectors, clock spring, sensors)
checks: The light should go out after about 7 seconds at start-up; if not, have it diagnosed
Don't probe SRS wiring yourself
faults.safety: Airbags can deploy during careless work; disconnect the battery and wait before any SRS service.

sequence.name: Start
sequence.desc: Brake pressed, smart key detected, push START: immobilizer releases, starter cranks, ECM synchronizes crank and cam signals and fires.

sequence.name: Warm-up (open loop)
sequence.desc: ECM runs from coolant temperature and airflow until the A/F sensor is hot, then switches to closed loop.

sequence.name: Driving
sequence.desc: ECM sets throttle, injection (port, direct or both), spark and cam timing from pedal, load and speed; knock control trims spark.

sequence.name: Emissions monitors
sequence.desc: During steady driving the ECM tests the catalyst, O2 sensors, EVAP and misfire; failures set codes and the check engine light.

sequence.name: Cooling
sequence.desc: Fans run on coolant temperature and A/C demand.

sequence.name: Braking
sequence.desc: ABS/VSC watches wheel speeds and modulates brake pressure when a wheel locks or slides.

checks.name: Oil and filter
checks.why: The engine runs thin 0W-16 oil and VVT depends on clean oil.
steps: Typical interval: 10,000 miles or 12 months; sooner in severe use
checks.src: 2022 Camry fluid types and capacities; Toyota typical schedule — confirm in your Warranty & Maintenance Guide

checks.name: Tire rotation and pressure
checks.why: Uneven wear and low pressure trigger TPMS and affect handling.
steps: Set cold pressure to the door-jamb label monthly
checks.src: Toyota typical schedule — confirm in your Warranty & Maintenance Guide

checks.name: Air and cabin filters
checks.why: A dirty air filter skews MAF readings and fuel trims.
steps: Inspect the engine air filter every 15,000 miles; replace about every 30,000
Replace the cabin filter per the guide
checks.src: Toyota typical schedule — confirm in your Warranty & Maintenance Guide

checks.name: Coolant, brake fluid and ATF
steps: Coolant: Toyota SLLC, 9.1 qt (8.6 L); first change typically at 100,000 miles
ATF: Toyota ATF WS (7.7 qt dry fill); inspect for condition
checks.src: 2022 Camry fluid types and capacities; Toyota typical schedule — confirm in your Warranty & Maintenance Guide

checks.name: Spark plugs
checks.why: Iridium plugs last long, but worn plugs cause misfires.
checks.src: Toyota typical schedule — confirm in your Warranty & Maintenance Guide

checks.name: Reading codes
checks.why: Codes plus freeze-frame data point to the cause.
steps: Plug a scan tool into the OBD-II connector under the dash
Record codes and freeze-frame data before clearing
Check fuel trims, coolant temperature and misfire counts in live data

Active misfire: reduce load and get it checked

defects.name: Car pulls to one side
defects.looks: Steering drifts left or right on a straight, level road.
isolate: Swap the front tires side to side: if the pull changes, it's the tire

causes.cause: Uneven tire pressure or a tire with internal damage (radial pull)
causes.fix: Set pressures; swap or replace the tire
Check for a hot wheel after driving; service the caliper

defects.name: Vibration at highway speed
defects.looks: Steering wheel or seat shakes, usually 55–70 mph.
isolate: Note whether it changes with speed (wheels/tires) or with engine rpm (engine/driveline)

causes.cause: Wheel out of balance or bent rim
Tire with flat spot or separated belt
Worn CV joint or engine mount

defects.name: Brake pedal pulsation or squeal
defects.looks: Pedal pulses when stopping, or brakes squeal.
isolate: Distinguish ABS activation (only in hard stops) from rotor runout (every stop)

defects.name: Fuel economy worse than normal
defects.looks: Noticeably fewer miles per gallon than the 28/39 mpg rating range.
isolate: Check for stored codes and fuel trims
defects.src: automotive service practice; A25A-FKS engine overview (cararac.com)

defects.name: Shudder or lurch when shifting
defects.looks: Shudder on 1–2 upshift or R–D engagement.
isolate: Check for transmission software updates and codes

causes.fix: Recalibrate or replace the torque converter
Check and service with Toyota ATF WS
